content.rules_text: Make a Spellcast Roll against a creature (living or dead) within Far range. On a success, spend a Hope to control the target by causing them to move, attack, or both. If you cause the creature to move, they move to a location you choose within Close range of them. If you cause the creature to attack, make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Melee range of them. On a success, deal d10 physical damage using your Proficiency.
